plainSummary: The plan lets people manage reusable workflows while preserving the steps and evidence of specs that already adopted them.
summary: Independently reviewed W-014 with the CLI related pack, its client/cli/lattice features, SL-003 read-only boundary, SL-023 operation parity, SL-024/030 workflow requirements, SL-029 navigation, proposed PC-023/024/025, related architecture/workflows.md and prior W-012/W-013 context. Reviewed portability, immutable adoption, required-stage semantics, create-only saves, expected-version conflicts, default fallback, editor validation ownership and navigation relocation. The initial SLC-02 expectedPaths omission of packages/ui/** was corrected before this review, covering its explicitly planned local write route. SL-032/033/034 are now live before snapshot creation. The written bet has independently fail-able verticals and preserves client-only UI imports and read-only server boundaries; no blocking spec contradiction remains. Builder must obtain real UI/operation evidence rather than treating source inspection as e2e proof.
residualRisks: The related CLI returned only: worktree scan is caution-only; authority is this checkout — use git worktree list yourself if needed. No structured sibling scan or skippedReason was supplied, so sibling checkout state was not established.

Security verification must exercise malformed, oversized, cross-site and wrong-token local UI requests and assert unchanged library state and no successful operation side effect on denial, with an allowed control.
The e2e requirement remains advisory in trust metadata; builder and independent code breaker must run browser and adapter checks explicitly.
Library data is outside source freshness and align coverage; operation trail and immutable-adoption behavior require dedicated checks.
